acceptanceCriteria: A fixture spec with a prose line beginning with a requirement ID or ID range passes while a real duplicate definition still fails.
The check's definition grammar is documented next to the check.
body: Observed 2026-10-09 in the V1-1061 lane (branch claude/v1-1061-appmap-enum-barrel, base dd90cfa6, corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360). make requirement-definitions-check counts any spec line that begins with a requirement ID as a definition, so a prose line such as 'AMAP-V0-024..026 are ...' in docs/specs/application-map-v0.md is reported as a duplicate definition. Expected: only the spec's declared definition form (the requirement row/heading syntax) counts; prose references are ignored. Actual: false duplicate refusal, forcing authors to reword prose.
title: requirement-definitions-check treats prose lines that start with a requirement ID as duplicate definitions
